merge_from_Message: merge the contents of another protobuf message into the current message using MergeFrom
copy_from_Message: copy the content of another protobuf message into the current message using CopyFrom
parse_from_string_Message: parse serialized protocol buffer data into a message using ParseFromString
serialize_to_string_Message: serialize a protobuf message to a binary string using SerializeToString
list_fields_Message: list all non-empty fields in a protobuf message using ListFields
